related_questions.question: How long do you lose your sense of taste with COVID?

text_blocks.snippet: Loss of taste due to COVID-19 can vary significantly, but it typically recovers within a few weeks for most individuals. While some may experience a rapid return of taste, others may take months for a full recovery. In a minority of cases, the loss of taste can be persistent.

list.title: Typical Recovery:
list.snippet: The majority of people who experience loss of taste from COVID-19 will regain their sense of taste within a few weeks.

list.title: Longer Recovery:
list.snippet: Some individuals may experience a slower recovery, with taste returning over a period of months.

list.title: Persistent Loss:
list.snippet: In a small percentage of cases, the loss of taste may be persistent and not fully recover.

list.title: Factors Affecting Recovery:
list.snippet: The extent of the initial loss of taste, individual factors, and the presence of Long COVID can influence the recovery timeline, according to Yale Medicine.
